retrievalProfile.description: A dense, hand-illustrated collage featuring multiple vignettes, scroll-work banners, and circular portraits in a 19th-century carnival or vaudeville style.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex, multi-layered illustration characterized by a sepia-toned, hand-etched texture. It features circular portrait medallions in the corners, a central curved banner for the primary title, and various narrative scenes depicted in a cross-hatched, colored-pencil style. The layout is busy, using scrolls and curved paths to guide the eye between different textual and visual elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular portrait medallions anchoring the four corners
A large, arched scroll banner dominating the upper third
Narrative vignettes separated by curved, organic borders
Dense, hand-lettered typography integrated into the illustration
coreInvariants: Hand-etched cross-hatching texture across all elements
Muted, aged color palette with yellowed parchment backgrounds
Consistent use of scroll-work and banners for text containment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title is centered at the top in a large arched banner; secondary scenes and portraits are distributed symmetrically around the perimeter.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large arched banner in the upper center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the main banner, then spirals outward to the corner portraits and inward to the central narrative scenes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is 'horror vacui' style, filled with texture, text, and detail.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sepia and parchment yellow for backgrounds and skin tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black ink for outlines and cross-hatching
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted reds, blues, and greens within the vignettes
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast provided by dark ink lines against light paper.
paletteRestrictions: No neon or high-saturation modern colors
Limited to earth tones and faded primary colors

letterConstructionRules: Letters follow the arc of the banners
Heavy use of inline decorative stars and stripes
Variable widths to fit specific scroll segments
characterSpecificRedesigns: Stars embedded within the counters of uppercase letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of arched decorative display text with smaller, slanted sans-serif and serif callouts.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ornate, star-filled decorative style
Captures the heavy, hand-cut feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dense, hand-drawn collage in a 19th-century etched style. Include four circular portrait medallions in the corners, a large empty arched scroll banner at the top, and various narrative scenes in the center using colored pencil and cross-hatching on aged parchment.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-lettered decorative text into the banners. Use a Victorian slab-serif style with inline stars for the main title, following the curve of the scroll. Add smaller descriptive text in slanted, etched serif styles within the vignettes.

verificationChecks: Text follows the curvature of the banners
Cross-hatching texture is consistent across text and image
Color palette remains muted and aged
No modern digital artifacts are visible

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the sepia aging effect
Complexity of the inline letter decorations
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is warped correctly to banner shapes
Confirm color palette is limited to muted vintage tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Victorian Etched Collage + Arched Scroll Typography + Cross-Hatched Vignettes
